levels.goal: Survive everyday exchanges: introduce yourself, ask simple questions, understand signs and numbers.
Talk about the past and plans, handle errands and services, read short personal and practical texts.
Tell a story, give and justify an opinion, follow the radio and everyday official texts.
Argue, compare and nuance in speech and writing; follow longer articles and discussions. NCLC 7 territory.
